order: This one runs through the cross-vendor lane rather than the ordinary review track the later rounds follow, pairing an order with the account of the cross-vendor pass for reviewing the round two diff, bounded by the commit pair anchoring the initial round through the round two fixes. What the audit covers stops at that pair, never reaching back further than it has to reach. Make the call unambiguous, the verdict on that anchoring pair settles, outright, whether the two open work orders leave revise status; there is no middle reading of the diff that can stand in for that single call, since this cross-vendor pass is the gate the earlier rounds were building toward all along. Put both documents into roster/ as material that did not exist before. The pass alters only those two files; the rest stays put.
claims: The pass adds 136 lines to roster/ across two files that did not exist before, the order carrying sixty-five of them and the account seventy-one; the rest of roster/ stays untouched. The commit pair covered anchors the initial round through the round two fixes, reviewed through the cross-vendor lane. The account closes on the same point, this single verdict settles, outright, whether the two open work orders leave revise status.
